definitions.explanation: Can refer to literal gatekeepers or figurative guardians.

examples.japanese: {門番|もんばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告|つ}げた→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧。
examples.english: I gave my name to the gatekeeper.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{門番|もんばん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通行|つうこう}→通行：03436_tsuukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{許可|きょか}した→許可する：20063_kyokasuru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{編集者|へんしゅうしゃ}→編集者：09587_henshuusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{門番|もんばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧だ。
examples.english: That editor is like a gatekeeper of the publishing industry.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ (gate) + ⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ (guard, watch). Refers to a person who guards or controls access at a gate. Also used figuratively in modern Japanese to describe anyone who controls access to an organization, industry, or resource.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{門番|もんばん}: castle gatekeeper
- {門番|もんばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as gatekeeper
- {門番|もんばん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ような⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧: a gatekeeper-like role

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{守衛|しゅえい}→守衛：18227_shuei⟧: security guard (modern, at buildings or facilities)
- {番人|ばんにん}: watchman, guard (broader usage)
- ⟦{警備員|けいびいん}→警備員：09867_keibiin⟧: security guard (professional, modern)
- ゲートキーパー: gatekeeper (loanword, often used in business contexts)
